text:
maria: Heads-up — planning late-night surge window deploy at 23:00 UTC. Need cross-service pin for runtime v2.4.1, router v1.9.0, console v3.2. Should we pin API gateway too? Deploybot dry-run shows schema bump for session headers. TL;DR: want coordinated pin + quick rollback plan.

chris: +1 on pin. Do we have compatibility matrix for runtime v2.4.1 vs router v1.9.0? I remember a header split change. If schema bump requires gateway change, let's hold API as last step.

kevin: I ran smoke in staging: runtime v2.4.1 + router v1.9.0 passes end-to-end for 8k reqs; console UI has a list rendering regression on very long sessions. Suggest canary 5% traffic for 30m.

maria: Good catch on console. Can we do dedicated console pin to v3.2 with feature-flag off for long session rendering? If not, hold console to v3.1.8 and proceed with runtime+router.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Dry-run succeeded. Proposed sequence: 1) Pin runtime->2.4.1 2) Pin router->1.9.0 3) Pin console->3.1.8 (canary 5%) 4) Promote console to 100% if metrics OK. Commands: /deploy --pin runtime:2.4.1 --wait 600

ashley: Rollback criteria: 99p latency > 500ms for more than 3 minutes, or error rate > 0.5% for 5 minutes. If either met, immediate rollback of most recent service. Also add model-quality guard: prompt-regression alert > 2% fail on eval set triggers rollback.

sre-oncall: I'll create a short runbook in incidents for the window and watch 95/99 latency, 5xx rate, and request queue depth. Ops will keep slack notifications for autoscaler thrash.

chris: For API gateway: we should only change header schema if we can do header-compat shim. Otherwise keep API pinned to current v1.4.7 and use runtime feature-flag to accept both headers.

maria: OK. New sequence approved: runtime -> router -> console (canary 5%) -> console promote. Kevin/ashley/sre-oncall to monitor. ETA 23:00 UTC tonight. I'll post release notes.

kevin: I'll run the canary and collect perf traces. Pushing a small probe script: curl -H "X-Session: test" https://api.redwood.ai/health?sig=canary -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' | tee traces.log

ashley: tagging alerts: #latency-canary, #console-regression, #model-quality. If anything noisy, I hit abort.

maria: thanks all. I'll add pinned versions to release notes and update release-bot. If we decide to rollback, do we pin back to runtime 2.4.0 and router 1.8.9, console 3.1.8 (current) — confirmed?

deploy-bot: Note: rollback command: /deploy --pin runtime:2.4.0 --router:1.8.9 --console:3.1.8 --force

sre-oncall: I'll be on watch from 22:45 to 00:30. Ping me in thread during deploy.

chris: One more - confirm DB migration none? Maria: no migrations.

maria: final question: are release notes scoped? I'll keep short: pinned versions, canary %, rollback triggers, contact list.

ashley: ack :thumbsup:
